features: Up to 65 per cent additional charge to iPhone Air
Up to 12 W fast wireless charging on the go
description: Thin and light design-The iPhone Air MagSafe Battery was created exclusively for iPhone Air. Designed to slip into your pocket, it feels great in your hand and adds up to 65 per cent additional charge to iPhone Air — extending battery life further than the battery life of any other iPhone. Smart behaviour-Attach the MagSafe Battery to your fully charged iPhone Air for all-day use. To maximise battery life, the combined system will choose the best times to recharge. Or when you need a quick boost, just snap it on for up to 12 W of fast wireless charging on the go. Fast charging-For even faster charging of your iPhone Air, attach the MagSafe Battery and connect it to a 20 W or higher power adapter at the same time.
